confirmedFindings.title: Missing Padding on Odd-Length Opus Frame Slices
confirmedFindings.body: Returning raw unaligned Buffers for odd-length Opus frames without 16-bit word boundary alignment causes memory alignment faults and truncated packet reads on downstream hardware media bridges.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Ensure payload length is padded to even byte boundary or set the RTP header padding bit appropriately.
